abstract: Seventeen teratomas with well-differentiated pancreatic tissue were found in 469 cases obtained from the files in our respective departments for the last ten years. These cases included 11 cases with a teratoma located in the anterior mediastinum, five cases with a teratoma located in the sacrococcygeal region, and one case with a teratoma located in the retroperitoneal space. The islets of Langerhans, as well as exocrine elements, were usually found in the pancreatic tissue. The blood glucose level was mildly depressed in one case of five teratomas, and a very high amylase level was observed in one other case. These levels were estimated in the fistulous discharge from the teratoma. Therefore, we felt that the pancreatic tissue observed in the teratomas was similar in nature to normal pancreatic tissue both histologically and functionally.
abstract_ja: 過去10年間に当施設の記録から集めた469例のうち、膵組織を含む奇形腫17例を発見した。このうち11例は前縦隔、5例は仙骨尾骨部、1例は後腹膜腔に存在した。ランゲルハンス島および外分泌成分が通常認められた。奇形腫からの瘻孔排液で測定した血糖値は5例中1例で軽度低下、別の1例ではアミラーゼ値が著明高値であった。奇形腫内の膵組織は、組織学的にも機能的にも正常膵組織と類似していると考えられた。
